description: Rosemeier, Malo and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The analytical and numerical formulation tailors trailing-edge structural tests using a 34 m blade and a 2.5 MN rig. The source addresses static and fatigue testing and compares the targeted loading conditions. A related trailing-edge test-comparison publication supplies supporting validation context, while exact specimen or campaign equality is not established. This model supports structural-test design for the documented blade setting. The publication metadata do not establish a general validated model of every adhesive joint or an openly licensed source implementation. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
